featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed and concerned about the reporting accuracy at this facility. I recently had a DEXA scan done here, and the center misclassified my biological sex as female on the official report.

Because DEXA scans evaluate bone density, T-scores, and health risk profiles based entirely on demographic baselines, a mistake like this completely invalidates the results. It skews the health interpretations and can easily lead to incorrect medical advice or missed risk factors.

When I brought this major discrepancy to the management's attention (handled by the manager, Tausif) to ask for a corrected report or a refund, the issue was not resolved satisfactorily. Since I am only in Mumbai temporarily, getting a rescan here isn't a viable option.

A diagnostic center's primary job is precision. If they cannot get basic demographic data right, you cannot trust the medical data they generate. Be incredibly careful and double-check every line of your reports if you choose to use this facility. I definitely won't be returning and highly recommend no one else to visit here.
